title: Sistema Dos Ojos - QRSS line plot (July 1996)
credits: Quintana Roo Speleological Survey, July 1996 ("Many entrances have not been labeled")

exclude.why: title 'Sistema Dos Ojos, Quintana Roo, QRSS, July 1996 (Many entrances have not been labeled.)'

entrances.name: Dos Palmas (not labeled: the thick knot on the main line where its Open Caves position lands)

controlPoints.name: The Pit
controlPoints.why: Open Caves position, at the Pit's clearing (satellite); the plot doesn't label it: the bottom of the small loop where the SW branch turns SE toward Pet Cemetery (the ADC guideline map's Pit bend)

controlPoints.name: Dos Palmas
controlPoints.why: Open Caves position; the plot's only unlabeled entrance dot, ~870 m east of Dos Ojos along the main line

controlPoints.name: Dos Ojos (West)
controlPoints.why: Google Maps position; the plot's 'Dos Ojos entrance' dot lands ~80 m east, between OpenStreetMap's 1st Eye (20.32451,-87.39076) and Bat Cave: which eye the dot marks and where each eye is are uncertain, so it only checks

controlPoints.name: Kentucky Castle ("KC" placemark on the QRSS Google Earth line plot, placed by sac-aktun-dos-ojos-google.json)

symbols.why: computer line plot: no depths, letter codes, flow arrows or bones; only the 'Maravilla section' name

trace.why: b/w computer line plot: survey lines only (a stick map), no walls, no symbols

placementWhy: Similarity fit (1.927 m/px, -3.4 deg) through The Pit and Dos Palmas (both Open Caves, on-site; neither labeled on the plot, identified by the Pit's loop and the knot on the main line ~870 m east of Dos Ojos) and Kentucky Castle (the QRSS Google Earth plot's KC placemark): residuals 18, 6, 16 m. The scale bar gives 2.01 m/px (+4%), the north arrow is 3.4 deg off. The 'Dos Ojos entrance' dot lands 76 m ENE of the database's Dos Ojos West (Google Maps), 36 m from OpenStreetMap's 1st Eye: a check only. Without Dos Palmas the fit puts Dos Palmas 110 m and Dos Ojos 130 m too far east. Checked against the placed sac-aktun-dos-ojos-google (Maravilla section and north branch line for line) and sac-actun-mpo-tulum (the SE branch toward Xel-Ha lies between the two, nearer QRSS 2012).
